mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 67 degrees with clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park. We are seeing an elevated air quality index of 54, a stunning Full Moon overhead, and if you stay up until 3:26 AM, you can spot the space station rising over Cross Plains before it heads toward Madison. Tonight, the low will be 61 degrees and we are not expecting any rain.

In city news, Mayor Diaz has designated September 2026 as Hunger Action Month to help combat food insecurity, which impacts one in eight residents in Southwest Wisconsin. Additionally, be aware that flagging will occur on Highway M this coming Monday and Tuesday for utility work, so please plan for potential travel delays.

There is plenty to do locally, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers' Market at the Capitol and more live music at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, the Verona Area Kids Triathlon and the Girls Try Hockey event both take place this Saturday.

Looking at the weekly police report, on August 19, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash on North Main Street at Bering Drive. Both drivers were cited for various traffic violations following the collision, though thankfully only minor injuries were reported.
Today's flavor of the day is OREO Cookie Overload. The store is currently open, but please note that it is closing soon in under 24 minutes.
